0 Irreproachable Hero I Yielding up this jewel, I shall not

Witnessing Vaidehi's tears and lamentations, the mighty

" 0 Goddess, thy misfortunes have rendered Rams's features

reduce Lanka to ashes. 
Having slain Ravana in combat, 
those two scions of the House of Raghu will take thee back 
to their own city, 0 Large-eyed Lady ! 0 Irreproachable

Sita answered:-" I have already furnished thee with an

Receiving the marvellous pearl, the Prince of the Monkeys 
inclined his head to that exalted one and prepared to depart. 
Beholding that foremost of monkeys expanding his form 
and, charged with energy, preparing to leap, her face bathed 
in tears, in a voice choked with sobs, Sita said to him :-
" 0 Hanuman, do not fail to offer my good wishes for their

brief.summary_1line: Hanuman reassures Sita, receives her jewel as a token for Rama, and departs carrying her message and hope of imminent rescue.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sita, tearful in the Ashoka grove, hands her shining pearl jewel to Hanuman as he bows before her.
Hanuman expands his form to leap away while Sita watches with tear-filled eyes, raising her hands in farewell.
Sita sitting beneath trees in the grove, clutching the jewel that once adorned her forehead as she speaks of Rama.
